implement.summary:
Defect on BASE_SHA (8ba4849d): supabase/functions/api/accountDeletionOperations.ts (runClaimedDeletion, ~L440-520 on base) returned `deleted:true` as soon as the SQL receipt reported `completed`; nothing in the Edge path inventoried the owner's namespaces, so residue rows (e.g. a leftover `shots` row) were reported as a completed deletion; there was no owner-namespace registry or pagination (W07-06 `readOwnerInventory` existed but was unused by deletion); index.ts (~L4215-4240) wired no inventory reader; legal.ts support page / Terms 8 / Terms 12 did not state that deletion leaves used free ratings spent nor what the identity ledger retains (Privacy §7/§8 did). The r1 candidate additionally read 16 tables with the service-role PostgREST client, which the migrations' privilege model forbids (service_role SELECT only on billing_entitlements/account_external_credentials/webhook_events) — VERIFIED on the disposable DB.

Fix (HEAD 4d7ccb87, two commits: 899c202e test-first, 4d7ccb87 implementation): (1) `ACCOUNT_OWNER_NAMESPACES` registers all 14 owner-scoped, owner-readable tables with owner + key columns; `ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNREAD_TABLES` classifies every other account-linked table as cascade_only (analysis_permit_tombstones, account_deletion_feedback ON DELETE SET NULL, api_private.billing_verification_tickets), rpc_owned (account_deletion_requests, account_external_credentials — fenced behind the deletion RPCs) or retained (free_rating_ledger, webhook_events, api_private.account_deletion_operations), and the live-PG test asserts this partition covers every FK to auth.users plus the ledger. (2) `verifyOwnerNamespacesEmpty` runs the W07-06 keyset-paginated `readOwnerInventory` per namespace: page errors are retried up to 3 times then `unread`; clamped/oversized pages, repeated cursors, malformed or cross-owner rows and budget exhaustion are `unread`; only a complete, empty inventory is `empty`; anything else withholds completion (`completion_unverified`, retryable 503). (3) A pre-flight one-row readability probe of every namespace runs BEFORE Apple revocation, RevenueCat deletion and the Auth-delete intent, so an unreadable inventory can never be discovered only after the caller's session has been destroyed (resolves adversary break #2: the sweep that can block now runs while the bearer is still valid). (4) After Auth deletion the full sweep runs again before `deleted:true`, and an already-`completed` claim is re-verified before its receipt is handed out (resolves adversary break #1 for the confirm/claim surface). (5) index.ts wires `readOwnerNamespacePage` through the deleting user's authenticated client (`authed.db`, RLS `*_select_own` + restrictive `api_requests_only`, which depend only on the JWT `sub` and the API key — VERIFIED from pg_policies / is_api_request() on the disposable DB), never the service role, so no grant/RLS change is needed and REVIEW.md's service-role boundary is respected. Order stays Apple revoke → RevenueCat delete → Auth delete. (6) legal.ts support page, Terms §8 and Terms §12 now say deletion does not restore used free ratings, that only a one-way hash of the sign-in identity + scored count is kept (no email/name/account id), and point at Privacy §7/§8 (APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md-compliant wording; no new product claims). Test harness/fixtures were extended to model owner-filtered paged reads, service-role denial and the Auth cascade so the existing 843 tests still pass alongside the 16 new ones (859/0/0).
